column1: # NPCs that stand somewhere while their event is on (event empty: all year). Event keys are the
# SeasonalEvents / HolidayEvents event names. Major towns: Henesys, Ellinia, Perion, Kerning City, Lith Harbor,
# Orbis, El Nath, Ludibrium, Mu Lung.
# Halloween: Spin Man (the Haunted Mansion's host) in the towns
# the Gloomy Mask is hidden in the map data (only scripts showed it)
# Christmas: Rooney (to Happyville, the story) and the Paperboy (the story's first news) in the towns
# holiday events (HolidayEvents): Cassandra (Winter Preparations, Spring Flower Festival) and Cody
# (Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving) in the towns; the Ace of Hearts in Ludibrium; Gaga and Mad Bunny in
# Henesys at Easter; Jr. Officer Medin (Winter Preparations) in Omega Sector
# the Lunar New Year (Cassandra's Game of Yut and soup; Kid Draco in Henesys)
# the Maple Music Festival (DJ JM takes players to the Campgrounds)
# Secret Agent (all year): Agent E recruits in the towns; the agents work from the M-Forcer Operations HQ
# story NPCs that GMS only placed through scenes: Chumji at Goblin Hill (Korean Folk Town, 30429)
# The Afterlands: the Old Man in Henesys (all year), the Solar Pulley in the Land of Warriors, and the
# prologue's Suspicious Sorcerer in Henesys while Halloween is on
